title: rodent
description: lightweight-ish vanilla modpack with some nice-to-have mods
body:
lightweight-ish vanilla modpack with some nice-to-have mods

### notable features
- animations from [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations)
- shader support through [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)
- extended view distance through [voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy)
- [3D Skin Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers)
- [AmbientSounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds) and [Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered)
- various optimization mods
